artboards.name: cart-page
artboards.role: Cart / checkout-summary page: dark header with nav and cart badge, a two-column body (selected order items + the Delivery Destination entry form on the left, order totals + promo code + checkout CTA on the right), and a dark site footer. The Delivery Destination card (node 13:321) is the subject of this story.

open_questions.detail: The Street Address, Apt/Suite, and Special Delivery Instructions fields inside the Delivery Destination card (node 13:321) already contain full sentence values ("128 Pizzaiolo Boulevard", "Penthouse 4B", "Ring doorbell or leave at front lobby desk..."). Since this story's whole subject is 'delivery details entry', it matters whether these should render as real, editable saved-address values or as placeholder text in otherwise-empty inputs.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Mapped the three fields as populated TextInput/Textarea values (a returning customer's saved default address, pre-filled and editable), not as `placeholder` attributes on empty inputs.

options.label: Pre-filled saved address — values are real defaults for a returning customer; inputs start populated exactly as drawn
Placeholder/example copy only — inputs should start empty; this text is illustrative formatting guidance, not real data

open_questions.detail: Diavola and Rosemary Garlic Focaccia rows (13:292, 13:309) show quantity 1 with a normal-looking '-' button. No disabled/greyed state, or a 'decrementing below 1 removes the item' confirmation, is drawn.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Assumed clicking '-' at quantity 1 removes the line item (same effect as the Remove action) rather than the button being disabled at the floor.

open_questions.detail: The Promo Code field (13:362) only shows the successful 'Applied' state (populated input, check-circle icon, green 'Applied' pill). No idle/empty state, invalid-code error state, or a way to remove/edit an already-applied code is drawn.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Assumed PromoCodeField needs an idle state (empty input, neutral 'Apply' button label) and an error state (red border + inline message), built from the existing --brand/--success semantic colors, in addition to the drawn Applied state.

open_questions.topic: Two different ETA values on the same page
open_questions.detail: The header shows 'Estimated delivery: 30 mins' (13:258) while the Delivery Destination card shows 'Est. Delivery: 25-35 mins' (13:328) for the same order.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Treated these as two intentionally independent data-bound values — a general site-wide estimate in the header vs. an address-specific calculated range in the delivery card — rather than a single shared value that should be reconciled.

open_questions.detail: The frame only shows a cart populated with 3 items. No empty-cart state (e.g. 'Your cart is empty' with a CTA back to the menu) is designed anywhere in this frame.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Out of scope for this mapping; flagging so an empty-cart state is designed and confirmed before the cart/checkout flow ships.

open_questions.detail: No error, required-field, or inline-success validation states are drawn for Street Address, Apt/Suite, or Special Delivery Instructions.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Assumed Street Address is required (blocks 'Proceed to Checkout' if empty) while Apt/Suite and Special Delivery Instructions are optional; exact validation rules and error copy still need confirmation.
